about.title: A neighbourhood clinic built for every member of the family
body: Crown Multispeciality Clinic was set up to solve a simple problem for families around Mugalivakkam Road and Moulivakkam — having to travel to different parts of the city for a general check-up, a child's vaccination, or a women's health consultation.

Under one roof, our team covers general medicine, paediatric care, and women's health, so most families can get the care they need without hopping between clinics. We keep both morning and evening slots open, because most working families in this area need appointments after office hours, not just before.
highlights: General medicine, paediatrics & women's health under one roof
Evening appointments until 9 PM, six days a week
Family-friendly care for every age group

faqs.question: Which specialities are available at Crown Multispeciality Clinic?

faqs.question: How do I book an appointment?

blogPosts.title: Why a Multi-Speciality Clinic Makes Sense for Busy Families
blogPosts.excerpt: Between a child's vaccination, a parent's blood pressure check, and your own annual physical, most families juggle more clinics than they'd like. Here's why one address can be enough.
blogPosts.author: Dr. Arun Kumar
content: It's a familiar pattern for families in growing neighbourhoods like Moulivakkam: one clinic for the kids, another for general check-ups, and a separate specialist across town for anything else. Each trip means new paperwork, a new doctor learning your history from scratch, and time that busy families simply don't have.

A multi-speciality clinic solves this by keeping general medicine, paediatric care, and women's health under a single roof. When your child needs a vaccination and you need a routine blood pressure check, both can often happen in the same visit, at the same address.

There's also a continuity benefit that's easy to underestimate. When one clinic holds your family's records across specialities, a doctor treating your child can quickly reference a relevant family history, and vice versa — something that's much harder when care is scattered across unconnected clinics.

Evening hours matter just as much as the range of specialities. Most working parents can't take time off during the day for a routine visit, which is why we keep the clinic open until 9 PM on most days — so care fits around your schedule, not the other way around.
